data.name: Reggie, His Cousin, Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World
data.detailed_description:
Control gravity. Break time. Save the universe.
Winner of Best Game For Kids (Gamescom Latam), Best Portable Game (Devcom), and part of the 2026 Indie Live Expo official selection. This gravity-defying 2D platformer blends fast-paced action with a chaotic time-travel adventure. Play as Reggie and master gravity itself in a universe where science, and reality, are on the brink of collapse.

The Universe Is in Danger!

Reggie, an unlikely hero from the 16,000th century, is thrown into a mission far beyond his understanding: preserve the scientific discoveries that hold the universe together before they are erased forever.

Every jump and flip takes you deeper into a world that’s falling apart.

Master Gravity

Take full control of movement with the Multi-Gravity Switch system and redefine how a platformer plays:

  • Instantly flip gravity at any time

  • Chain flips and takedowns into high-speed combos

  • Dig, flip, and maneuver through levels with fluid control

  • Build momentum and push movement mechanics to their limits

  • SLAY enemies using fast, platformer-driven combat

Meet The Cast:

  • Reggie - The unlikely hero of our epic adventure. Round, cheerful, a tad clumsy, and born in the distant sixteen-thousandth century. Armed with gravitational powers, Reggie must conquer many challenges to mend timelines and revive science in his far-flung future.

But he won't be doing this alone:

  • Cousin - Reggie’s cousin, joining the adventure in multiplayer and bringing their own energy to the mission

  • Car Sagan - a brilliant scientist… who is also a car, helping guide you through the madness of time travel

  • Vinegar - Another brilliant scientist, a human mind trying to keep things grounded as everything spirals out of control

Features:

  • There’s more waiting beyond the mechanics:

  • 80 hours of story-driven gameplay across multiple time periods

  • Fully animated and voiced cutscenes bringing the story to life

  • Local co-op with two unique modes:

    • Dynamic Split-Screen Mode

    • Synergy Mode (one controls Reggie, the other controls gravity)

  • Challenging bosses that test your mastery of movement

  • A world filled with secrets, humor, and chaos

data.short_description: Reggie's peaceful life is interrupted by a wild time-travel mission! Step into a playable hand-drawn animated story where you'll break physics to master the flow of gravity. Meet an absurd cast and uncover deep mysteries to fix (or screw) the universe’s future.

English*, Spanish - Spain, Japanese*, French, German, Portuguese - Brazil*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
